scenarios.label: Control — current point-size pass
scenarios.hypothesis: Current control is the baseline against which all Phase 2 scenarios are measured.
scenarios.expectedEffect: No code changes. Produces baseline scorecard.

scenarios.label: Sigma-only reduction
scenarios.hypothesis: Kernel softness is still the main reason FORM edges are smearing at lock/drift.
changeInstructions: Reduce lock beat uGaussianSigma by 0.1 from the current control value.
Reduce drift beat uGaussianSigma by 0.1 from the current control value.
Do not change point size, camera, opacity, depth, or verb structure.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Sharper letter edges and clearer counters, especially at 7800ms and 9800ms.

scenarios.label: Replace the transition verb
scenarios.hypothesis: The 5000ms transition verb is the main source of silhouette collapse.
changeInstructions: Replace the current 5000ms transition verb (velocity_rest in control) with coalesce.
Keep camera, point size, and uniform intent as close as possible to control.
Do not modify later lock/drift beats.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Less collapse from readable FORM into blurred FRM during transition.

scenarios.label: Word authority diagnostic — force FORM
scenarios.hypothesis: Multiple word authorities are degrading the glyph target geometry.
changeInstructions: Temporarily change stages.velocity.word to FORM.
Temporarily change visual.letterGeometry.velocity.word to FORM.
Do not change beats, uniforms, or camera.
If both values are already FORM in control, record the run as a no-op and discard it.
scenarios.expectedEffect: If readability materially improves after an actual value change, word authority mismatch is a real root cause.

scenarios.label: Depth falloff reduction
scenarios.hypothesis: Foreground exaggeration is painting over the glyph and collapsing edge clarity.
changeInstructions: Reduce lock beat uDepthFalloffPower by 0.2 from the current control value.
Reduce drift beat uDepthFalloffPower by 0.2 from the current control value.
Do not change point size, sigma, opacity, camera, or verbs.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Less foreground overfill and improved edge/counter clarity.

scenarios.label: Camera pullback +2
scenarios.hypothesis: The current camera is too close and overfills the glyph.
changeInstructions: Move lock beat camera z back by +2 from the current control value.
Move drift beat camera z back by +2 from the current control value.
Do not change point size, sigma, opacity, depth, or verbs.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Slightly smaller but cleaner FORM at lock/drift.

scenarios.label: Lock point size -1
scenarios.hypothesis: Lock readability may improve if only the lock kernel thickness is reduced while drift remains unchanged.
changeInstructions: Reduce 7600ms lock beat pointSize by 1 from control.
Do not change 9400ms drift pointSize.
Do not change sigma, opacity, depth, camera, verbs, or architecture.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Cleaner lock edges/counters at 7800ms without harming 9800ms drift readability.

scenarios.label: Lock sigma -0.15
scenarios.hypothesis: Lock-only kernel sharpening may improve lock readability/dominance where global sigma reduction was insufficient.
changeInstructions: Reduce 7600ms lock beat uGaussianSigma by 0.15 from control.
Do not change 9400ms drift sigma.
Do not change point size, opacity, depth, camera, verbs, or architecture.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Sharper lock silhouette at 7800ms while preserving existing drift behavior at 9800ms.

scenarios.label: Lock opacity tighten
scenarios.hypothesis: Lock remains visually embedded because lock-level particle opacity is still too filled/overpainted.
changeInstructions: Reduce 7600ms lock beat uOpacityMax from control.
Reduce 7600ms lock beat uOpacityMin from control.
Do not change 9400ms drift opacity.
Do not change point size, sigma, depth, camera, verbs, or architecture.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Cleaner lock separation and stronger word dominance at 7800ms without drift regressions at 9800ms.

scenarios.label: Lock spread tighten
scenarios.hypothesis: Lock readability remains weak because lock spread is still too broad, smearing the lock silhouette.
changeInstructions: Reduce 7600ms lock beat uSpreadFactor from control to 0.82.
Do not change 9400ms drift spread.
Do not change point size, sigma, opacity, depth, camera, verbs, or architecture.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Tighter lock silhouette and improved 7800ms readability/dominance without 9800ms regressions.

scenarios.label: Lock isolate pulse
scenarios.hypothesis: Scalar lock tuning is exhausted; lock requires a short structural isolate composition to establish clear subject dominance.
changeInstructions: Recompose the lock moment into a short isolate pulse around 7800ms.
Keep 9400ms drift behavior unchanged unless strictly required for continuity.
Do not alter unrelated architecture or blueprint logic.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Improved lock subject clarity/dominance at 7800ms beyond scalar-only scenarios.

scenarios.label: Sigma + refined lock isolate
scenarios.hypothesis: A sigma keeper baseline plus a refined lock-local isolate window can outperform scalar lock tuning and lift 7800 lock dominance.
changeInstructions: Start from sigma_only_minus_0_1 values.
Apply a refined lock isolate composition window around the lock checkpoint.
Keep drift behavior aligned to the sigma baseline.
Use hardened lock checkpoints (for example: 7700/7800/7900/8300) in addition to standard checkpoints.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Higher lock readability/dominance at 7800ms while retaining sigma-based drift quality.

scenarios.label: Target density remediation (ppl 800)
scenarios.hypothesis: Lock readability is constrained upstream because too few particles are assigned to FORM target geometry.
changeInstructions: Change visual.letterGeometry.velocity.particlesPerLetter from 200 to 800.
Do not change beat sheet, camera, point size, sigma, opacity, depth, spread, or architecture.
scenarios.expectedEffect: Material increase in text-assigned particle ratio and improved lock readability/dominance.
